tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window ground: behind the sidebar and around the inset content panel. Docs page background in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The inset content panel that holds every view, the side peek, dialogs. Docs page background in light.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Task cards and menus. In light, cards separate from `surface` by `border`, not by shade.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs and code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected fill for nav items, list rows and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines: panel edge, card edge, row dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Card hover edge, secondary button edge.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects, checkboxes, radios and switches. At least 3:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, property labels, inactive nav. Legible on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: IDs, timestamps, counts, placeholders. 4.5:1 on every surface token.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary button in a view: white in dark, near-black in light.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text on `primary`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Sea. Work in motion: Building and Shepherding status icons, links, focus ring, the selected card edge. Never a button fill. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected docs nav item; the faint fill behind a selected task card.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `accent` fill (switch knob, sea app icon).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Needs you: a question, a plan to approve, a review. The In review status icon and the 'Needs you' flag. The only colour that asks a person to act.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or cancelled status icon, error text, the Cancel task menu item.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind an error banner.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done status icon and passing checks. Always with its icon; never told apart from `danger` by hue alone.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind the command palette and dialogs.
